lines.speaker: Birdie
lines.text: You're the new projectionist! The fields are full of loose frames.

lines.speaker: Birdie
lines.text: Mind the slimes — they love a good splash. Parry their lunge and they turn to puddles.

lines.speaker: Birdie
lines.text: The big scarecrow in the barn... he thinks he's still on set. Don't let him believe it.

lines.speaker: Inkwell Owl
lines.text: The last reel is torn, child. Every world is losing its picture.

lines.speaker: Inkwell Owl
lines.text: Recover the master frames. They are the projector's memory.

lines.speaker: Inkwell Owl
lines.text: When Barnaby falls, the barn door opens. Then... the projector itself will wake.
